column1: Our sustainability work starts with taking
accountability for our operational footprint. In 2020,
Microsoft made industry-leading commitments to be
carbon negative, water positive, and zero waste by
2030, and to protect more land than we use by 2025.
This means taking accountability for our operational
footprint across our campuses, datacenters, devices,
software, and value chain. We look at our operations
across the entire lifecycle of assets and products, from
design to building, usage, and end of life. We are
committed to sharing our learnings, accelerating
markets, scaling solutions across our value chain,
and being transparent about our progress.
